---
title: PubMed
description: "PubMed citations, one row per PMID, from the cdsci-lake PubMed table: title, abstract, journal, authors, MeSH terms, references and grants."
---

[PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov) is the citation database behind
every `pmid` in the release. `annotation.pubmed__article` has one row per
PMID with title, abstract, journal, authors (with ORCID where given),
publication date, MeSH headings, publication types, chemicals, keywords, DOI,
cited references, and grants. It is read from the
[cdsci-lake](https://github.com/seandavi/cdsci-lake) PubMed table
(`lake.omicidx.pubmed_article`), not from a bioc-on-ice source module.

## Licence and citation

[NLM Terms and Conditions](https://www.nlm.nih.gov/databases/download/terms_and_conditions.html)
for PubMed data. Cite PubMed and NLM.

## Join keys

- `pmid` (text) joins `annotation.ncbi__gene_pubmed.pubmed_id`, `annotation.icite__publication.pmid`, `annotation.pubtator3__mention.pmid`, `raw.bugsigdb__full_dump.pmid` and `clinical.gwas_catalog__study.pubmed_id`.
- `references` is a list of (citation, pmid) structs; `authors` and `grant_ids` are lists of structs.
- MeSH terms are one `; `-separated string of `Dnnnnnn:Heading / Qnnnnnn:Qualifier`, with `*` marking a major topic.

## Good to know

- Missing values are the empty string, not NULL.
- This table has no row in `provenance.release`: its version is the lake's, not an upstream release number.
- A small fraction of the PMIDs in `gene2pubmed` are newer than the lake's load and not yet here.
